name: comp-310
title: Sale Countdown Banner
blurb: Sale countdown banner with live timer, ticket icon, and buy now button.
description: Dark sale banner with ticket icon, sale headline, live countdown timer showing days/hours/minutes/seconds via useEffect RAF loop, Buy now button, and dismissible close.
use_when: You need to create urgency for a time-limited sale with a visible countdown.
avoid_when: For non-time-critical promotions; use simpler announcement banners instead.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; icon wrapper marked aria-hidden. Timer updates every second via setInterval.
